title: Gate C route-decision envelope and validation contract

authority_verbatim: Route choice made on concrete info: goal, boss/danger, expected trophy/material/item family, depth, branch consequence, extraction/return condition.

content_neutrality.policy: This contract defines shapes, states, and evidence citations only. It contains no campaign, reward, economy, risk, or balance value, no concrete goal text, and no expected item-family content. All such content is owner product authority and stays null/owner-pending here.

route_identity.requirement: Identify the route being decided: road, direction, node identity, and charted tier/status.

wire_shape.road: roadId + roadName + direction + blurb (blurb is terrain flavor, not a goal)
wire_shape.node: nodeId + name + template + layout + index + status (cleared|open|barred)
wire_shape.lineage: parentId and childIds on the browser surface; parentId only on the native surface (parity P1)

route_identity.notes: Identity is fully on the wire today, but identity alone fails the Gate C contract by definition (NATIVE_PRODUCT_CONVERGENCE.md:72). Node identity is intentionally not cross-server stable (TASK-0086 parity P2); this contract does not reconcile it - that is an owner/implementation ruling, not a contract field.

concrete_goal.requirement: A concrete, route-specific goal that makes choosing this route meaningful.
evidence: MISSING per TASK-0086 FINDINGS.md '1. Concrete goal': no goal/objective key exists on either chart builder (server/core/world-web.js:203-216,254-269; native/src/networking.cpp:1424-1437).
The only route-adjacent goal loop is the route-agnostic first goal (server/core/first-goal.js:48-55; native mirror networking.cpp:1554-1558), which assigns no per-road or per-node purpose.
concrete_goal.smallest_future_owner_path: Owner authors the per-node/per-road goal content; implementation adds a goal label in the two chart builders (server/core/world-web.js buildChart; native/src/networking.cpp emit_chart_screen) consumed by src/components/game-panes/Chart.vue and the future native chart pane. Content is owner campaign authority and cannot be derived from code.

boss_or_danger.requirement: Named boss/danger and a coarse difficulty band visible before the route choice.

wire_shape.boss_name: wardenName = 'Warden of <node name>' on every node row; pinned as floor boss on zone entry
wire_shape.difficulty_band: levelHint derived from tier by levelHintForTier ('<floor>-<floor+4>'); rendered as 'Lv <hint>' on the browser chart
wire_shape.bounded_gap: exact pack composition is visible only after entry

boss_or_danger.smallest_future_owner_path: None required for the base condition. Optional native parity touch-up only: native chart rows omit levelHint (TASK-0086 parity P1).

expected_item_family.requirement: The expected trophy/material/item family a traveler should anticipate on this route.
evidence: MISSING per TASK-0086 FINDINGS.md '3. Expected trophy/material/item family': no chart/node key describes expected drops, trophies, materials, or item families on either surface (server/core/world-web.js:203-216,254-269; server/core/services/zone-service.js:112-128,199-215; native/src/networking.cpp:1424-1432).

The only drop guarantees live inside the commission chain and are discovered in-scene, not pre-announced per route (playtest/scenarios/quest.mjs:175-178); the legacy synthetic trophy event is retired (networking.cpp:1996-1997).
expected_item_family.smallest_future_owner_path: An owner-owned loot-table/family source keyed by road/template/tier, surfaced through both chart builders (server/core/world-web.js buildChart; native/src/networking.cpp emit_chart_screen). Table content is owner economy/reward authority. Candidate future owners per RUN_STATUS routing (suggestions, not claims): TASK-0104 itemization/history audit, TASK-0103 monster/encounter gap audit.

depth.requirement: How deep the route goes, visible before and authoritative inside the instance.

wire_shape.charted: tier on every node row; browser rows additionally carry the derived levelHint band
wire_shape.in_instance: instances generate at depth = node.tier; delve triggers carry metadata().depth; stairs metadata (stairsUp/stairsDown) on every instance snapshot

depth.smallest_future_owner_path: None required; optional parity touch-up only (native chart rows lack the derived levelHint string, parity P1).

branch_consequence.requirement: What choosing this route opens, closes, or forecloses.
branch_consequence.derivation: A client can compute 'clearing X opens Y and Z' for the immediate next stage purely from existing payloads: statuses (cleared|open|barred), the unlock rule (tier==1 or parentId cleared), parentId/childIds links, and in-zone gates naming child node + levelHint. No new gameplay rules are needed.
bounded_gaps: The frontier caps visibility at deepest cleared tier + 1 (server/core/world-web.js:246-252; native/src/networking.cpp:1414-1418), so multi-stage or terminal consequences are absent; changing that is an owner ruling plus a frontier-policy change in the two chart builders.
C++ chart rows omit childIds (TASK-0086 parity P1), so a native client currently lacks sibling links.
evidence: server/core/services/zone-service.js:164-189 (zoneGates), :351-358 ('No road holds past a living Warden.')
branch_consequence.smallest_future_owner_path: Immediate-stage presentation is computable now (Chart.vue / future native chart pane). Anything beyond the frontier needs an owner ruling on frontier policy; native sibling links need the P1 parity touch-up.

extraction_or_return.requirement: How the traveler leaves the route and what persists.

wire_shape.return: entry waymark (stairsUp) returns to the Crossroads; native pins stairs_up_returns_to_town and routes stairs-up through finish_extraction -> player:extract bank summary
wire_shape.persistence: cleared ground lies still inside a linger window (ZONE_LINGER_MS default 15 minutes) with 24h respawn suppression, communicated in the chart footnote

extraction_or_return.smallest_future_owner_path: None required for the base condition; per-node variation would live in zone-service gate sweeps and native stair handling.

owner_pending_content: Concrete goal content per route/node (campaign authority)
Owner ruling on multi-stage/terminal branch consequence beyond the frontier cap
Owner/implementation ruling on native/browser node identity reconciliation (TASK-0086 parity P2; deliberately NOT reconciled here)
completeness.rule: ready may become true only when every decision field state is AVAILABLE or DERIVABLE-WITHOUT-GAMEPLAY-RULES within its documented scope, no owner_pending flag is true, and missing_fields is empty. A route name, tier, or blurb alone remains invalid.

open_parity_observations.note: Recorded as open observations; none are resolved or reconciled by this contract.
